content.text: Co-sleeping is really common into the school years, and kids this age can handle a gradual move. Try a "stay and fade" start tonight. Do the usual bedtime routine in their own bed, sit on a chair next to it until they're drowsy, then move the chair a bit closer to the door every few nights. Tell them the plan in the afternoon, so bedtime isn't the first they hear of it. Let them pick a small thing for their room, like a new nightlight or a special stuffy, so the room feels like theirs.
